Tara: Quick sync  were doing a minimal base-image harden this evening at 22:00 PT. Need owners for RBAC delta, KMS key versioning, and audit forwarding.
Ibrahim: I can own KMS key versioning. Plan: create v4, sign test image, keep v3 active for 48h.
Kelsey: I'll take RBAC MR  scope binding to the specific key resource and limit to serviceAccount:ci-builder@redwood.
Tara: Also add cosign annotations (build_id, git_sha) and ensure cloudaudit -> splunk forwarder includes kms sign events.
SigBot: Preflight scan: base-image:2026-03-29-nightly -> 1 medium (openssl backport) flagged.
Ibrahim: Patch openssl in the rebuild and re-scan. If still flagged, we'll hold promotion to Dedicated.
Kelsey: MR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/510  includes roles/redwood.kmsSigner and condition limiting resource.name. PTAL @eng-security.
Tara: Canary plan: 10% canary for 30m, check image-pull errors and auth failures. If >3 pull failures or any auth error, pause and rollback.
Ibrahim: Test sign done. cosign command used: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKey/versions/4 gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-29-nightly` signature: sha256:c0ffee123
SigBot: Canary started 22:00 PT -> 8 pods in canary pool pulling new image.
Kelsey: Exported audit snippet shows sign by ci-builder@redwood and includes keyVersion=v4. I'll attach to MR.
Tara: Canary 20m check: health OK, no pull failures. Proceeding staged rollout.
Ibrahim: Leaving v3 enabled for 48h before disabling. Rollback: revert promotion to last-signed digest if needed.
SigBot: Event: rollout-complete recorded by Tara at 23:30 PT. Audit logs forwarded to splunk:index=images_audit.
Tara: Thanks everyone. I'll file compliance note and close the change ticket.
